title: Local testing of dictators
statement: For every natural number $n$, the odd BLR-and-AND tester is a local tester for the property of being a dictator, with testing rate equal to half the minimum rejection probability attained among Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube that are not dictators.
